title: Scribble: a doodle drawn on the blank canvas skips the picture age check
description: Fabio 2026-10-17: Scribble with 'a beautiful lady ... wearing lingerie' (and with '18-year-old') was refused because the describer answers YES to 'could be under 18' for a stick figure. A drawing made on the BLANK canvas carries no age and the words carry the subject, so it is not looked at; the typed words are still checked. An uploaded drawing/photo, a Reuse, and every other flow are still looked at.
